inputs.modified_text: Tensions in Nigeria’s health sector escalated on Thursday as workers under the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations protested controversial reform bills before the National Assembly. They gathered at Unity Fountain in Maitama, Abuja, and strongly opposed the proposed legislation.
